newsitem.title: USA: ARC Capital sees record Q4 profit.
newsitem.headline: ARC Capital sees record Q4 profit.

text.p: ARC Capital said Wednesday it expects a record profit of $1.2-$1.4 million on sales of about $10 million for the 1996 fourth quarter.
In a statement, the company also said its consolidated gross margins in the fourth quarter were above 50 percent.
It cited the "outstanding performance" of its SRC VISION subsidiary as a reason for the strong quarter. SRC Vision generated record sales and gross margins exceeding 56 percent, it said.
ARC Capital expects to announce fourth quarter earnings when it completes its audit in February.
